Synopsis:
A US Navy guided-missile destroyer (USS Benfold) lost power for four days in the South China Sea in late July, requiring a tow to the Philippines. Separately, the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier has been deployed for 200+ days with reports of sailor suicide attempts and low morale. The article highlights systemic US military overstretch driven by the ongoing Iran war, with Trump ordering reduced US-South Korea joint exercises. Senior military and political figures are clashing over the severity of the situation.
